summary: Marketing Email v3 stopped returning folderId on 2026-01-28
details:
HubSpot moved marketing email folders to a v2 folder system and added folderIdV2 to Marketing Email v3 responses. Both fields were returned side by side until folderId was removed on 2026-01-28; since then only folderIdV2 is returned, so code keyed on folderId gets no folder value.

Read folderIdV2 instead of folderId from /marketing/v3/emails responses and re-key any stored folder index on folderIdV2 (list emails with folderId__not_null to rebuild it); old folderId values no longer match anything the API returns.
